source: Activation checkpointing changes this balance by storing fewer activations and recomputing selected forward work during backward. That trades extra arithmetic for lower activation capacity, an explicit example of exchanging compute for memory. AS23 will cover the technique in depth.
zh: 激活检查点通过存储更少的激活并在向后过程中重新计算选定的前向工作来改变这种平衡。这是用额外的算术换取较低的激活能力，这是用计算换取内存的一个明确例子。 AS23 将深入介绍该技术。
